coffee.origin_source: Design 09§2.1 and 19§3: the exogenous Yemeni Sufi recipe; production and owner religion remain dynamic prerequisites.

profile_boundary: Static affinity priors; culture/religion keys, never region coefficients. Shared fitted params across every good/cell. Initial customs are 1337 facts.

events.source: 04§4.1 coffee.8: unique Catholic religious leader, at least one Catholic country x_c≥10. Uses the shared temporary multiplier class, not a fitted region/date coefficient.
04§4.2 tobacco.6: Muslim country x_c≥45; creates the P3 policy, does not require a pre-existing ban.
04§4.3 tea.2; engine east_asia.txt Japanese culture-group keys; bounded +7 shared event input.

secondary_channel: Ownership uses the population share at x≥20 outside the capital market, multiplied by lambda_ownership, fixed affinity and 1/(1+preemption). Merchant contact uses only non-territorial foreign residents, with its own lambda_contact. The yearly hazard is converted to monthly probability by 1-exp(-hazard/12), as in the original controller.
preemption_definition: Current rival above stage2: b=preemption*max(0,rival-20). Shared p, market input, contact/ownership hazards divide by (1+b); retention multiplies max(0,1-b/100). Bounded event/contact x increments remain exact. No geography/calendar in this rule.
wine_definition: Static region/religion context per handoff26 C1; no simulator or U item.
